build_system: None - static files served via GitHub Pages
verification_instructions: Open site1/index.html in a browser and verify visual appearance, responsiveness, and interactions. Check that CSS validates without errors.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - static HTML/CSS files
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - no external package installs. Google Fonts are referenced via link tags (load client-side for end users). No JavaScript allowed. Pure HTML + CSS only.
contribution_requirements: Pure HTML + CSS, no JavaScript, no frameworks. Must remain responsive. Google Fonts via link tags are acceptable.
key_patterns: Uses Inter (body) and Playfair Display (headings) fonts. Blue accent color #6C8EBF. CSS animations (fadeInUp, float). Section-based layout with .section class. Cards with hover transforms. Responsive breakpoint at 600px. prefers-reduced-motion respected.
directory_structure: site1/ contains index.html and style.css. Other sites (site2, site3) exist but are not the focus.
